name: Boku Mao!
source:
The hero who brought peace back to the land
fell by his own confidence to a seductive she-demon!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ112153.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
曾为大地带回和平的勇者，
却因自己的自负，败在了妖艳的女恶魔手中！

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ112153.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
